sum_insured_options: ₹50L – ₹300L (as per health check-up table; exact SI range not explicitly stated in wording)

room_rent.display: As per SI slab (room category linked to SI)
room_rent.note: Room category entitlement is linked to Sum Insured1 as per Policy Schedule; proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken. Exact category (e.g. single private) not specified in wording — depends on SI opted. ManipalCigna Health 360 add-on can modify room rent limit.

icu.note: ICU charges covered under Hospitalisation Expenses; no specific sub-limit mentioned. Associated Medical Expenses proportionate deduction does not apply to ICU.

copayment.display: None (base); 10% if intimation delayed >10 days; 20% for organ transplant at non-network without intimation
copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment on every claim. Conditional co-payments: 10% additional if hospitalisation not intimated within 10 days; 20% for organ transplant at non-network hospital without required intimation/biopsy. No zonal co-payment if lower-zone insured treats in higher zone.

sub_limits.display: Domiciliary capped at 10% of Base SI; few others
sub_limits.note: Domiciliary Expenses capped at 10% of Base Sum Insured1. Bariatric Surgery (optional Health+) capped at ₹5L. Air Ambulance (optional Health+) capped at ₹10L. Medical Devices (optional Health+) capped at ₹2L per 3 years. No disease-wise sub-limits on core hospitalisation benefits.

deductible.note: Annual aggregate deductible; optional at policy level. No deductible if not opted.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 24 months of continuous coverage from first policy inception (Excl01). Reducible via portability/migration credits.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions include cataract, hernia, piles, varicose veins, kidney/biliary stones, joint replacement, BPH, hydrocele, sinusitis, tonsils, gastric ulcer, cysts/polyps, PCOD, genito-urinary surgery, etc. Not applicable for accidents.

maternity.note: Maternity, newborn, first-year vaccination, infertility, surrogacy and oocyte donor cover available only via optional 'ManipalCigna Lifetime Plus' add-on. Waiting period and limits as per that add-on's terms. Base policy excludes maternity (Excl18).

cumulative_bonus.display: Not inbuilt; available via optional Lifetime Plus add-on
cumulative_bonus.note: Base India Plan does not include a cumulative/no-claim bonus. Cumulative Bonus on India SI1 is available only by opting the 'ManipalCigna Lifetime Plus' add-on. Rate and maximum not specified in this wording.

restoration.display: Unlimited restorations, partial or full SI
restoration.note: Restoration triggers every time Base SI1 is completely or partially utilised. Restored amount not available for same illness/same insured person in same policy year (including complications). Available for unrelated illnesses of same insured and any illness of other insured members. Unlimited times per year.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge.

day_care.note: All medically necessary day-care treatments/surgeries requiring less than 24 hours due to technological advancement are covered.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered when patient cannot be transferred or hospital bed unavailable; minimum 3 days treatment required. Several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation covered up to Sum Insured1. Excludes pleasure/rejuvenation services like Panchakarma, detoxification.

organ_donor.note: Inpatient hospitalisation expenses for organ harvesting from donor covered up to SI1. Excludes donor screening, organ acquisition cost, donor post-op complications, stem cell donation (except bone marrow transplant), organ transport.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered at reasonable and customary charges up to SI1; no fixed rupee cap stated. Air ambulance available as optional Health+ add-on up to ₹10L.

modern_treatments.note: 11 listed modern/advanced treatments covered (e.g. oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy injections, stereotactic radiosurgery, robotic surgery, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, etc.) under inpatient or day-care. Robotic/Cyber Knife also separately covered. Only listed procedures covered.

consumables.note: Non-medical items (List I consumables) are excluded from base plan. Coverage for non-medical items and medical devices available only via optional 'Health+' package. Non-medical items under Health+ covered up to SI1; medical devices up to ₹2L per 3 years.

global_cover.display: Not covered (India Plan); Worldwide Emergency via optional Lifetime Plus
global_cover.note: India Plan geographical scope restricted to India. Worldwide Medical Emergency Hospitalisation available only via optional 'ManipalCigna Lifetime Plus' add-on.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly premium modes and 15 days for monthly mode. Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period for new policies only; not applicable on renewals or portability/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines; accrued waiting period credits transferred.

notable_exclusions.display: Treatment outside India, OPD expenses, dental (non-accident), external congenital anomaly, infertility/ART, maternity (base), non-listed modern treatments, off-label drug use

optional_riders.display: Health+ (air ambulance, non-medical items, bariatric, hospi cash, concierge, tele-consult), Women+ (cancer screening/vaccination, gynaec consults), Lifetime Plus (maternity, cumulative bonus, worldwide emergency), Critical Illness add-on, Personal Accident Plus, Health 360 (OPD, room upgrade, restoration)
